purpose: Suite-level trigger eval seed. Each query is labeled with the skill that SHOULD win (expect), or null when no doctrine skill should fire (Resident-stratum-covered, general knowledge, or out of scope). Derive a per-skill run_loop set for skill X as should_trigger = (expect == X); every other query is a should-not-trigger near-miss for X. This is a seed set (~2-3 should-trigger per skill plus boundary near-misses); expand to 8-10 should-trigger per skill before optimizing descriptions.
